title: Checkpoint: sorted merge
prompt: Implement `ArrayList<Integer> merge(ArrayList<Integer> a, ArrayList<Integer> b)`: merge two sorted lists into a new sorted list, duplicates allowed, ties taking from `a` first. The lesson's three-loop structure maps directly — write it from the machines, not from memory.

tests.name: merged in order
tests.hint: Two-pointer while + two drain loops; ties take a first with <=.
